nodes.name: AI Code Reviewer
nodes.description: Spring Boot command-line application that sends source code files to locally hosted Ollama models and returns actionable feedback on bugs, performance and security problems.

nodes.name: Ollama
nodes.description: Locally running Ollama server at http://localhost:11434 hosting the gemma2, llama3.1, llama3.2, qwen2.5-coder and falcon3 models used to generate code reviews.

relationships.description: AI Code Reviewer submits source code for review to the Ollama OpenAI-compatible API.
